title: Product Catalog Schema
description: Schema for a single product entry. The seller agent reads catalog.json (a list of these) to answer buyer queries and validate proposed purchases.

sku.description: Unique product identifier, e.g. 'SHOE-001'. This is the ID the validator checks against, never the product name.

name.description: Human-readable product name shown to the buyer.

category.description: Broad category, used for buyer queries like 'show me shoes'.

price_inr.description: Price in INR. This is the ground truth the validator checks the agreed price against.

stock.description: Units available. 0 means out of stock; seller agent must reject orders for this SKU.

variants.description: Available options, e.g. sizes or colors. Empty array if not applicable.

active.description: If false, product is delisted and must never be sold even if stock > 0. Lets you simulate a delisted-item edge case.
